sources.facts: 300 x 4.6 mm, head length 7.0 mm and width 7.8 mm; UV-resistant PA66W black, nonreleasable plastic pawl; 100 pieces per bag. Manufacturer tensile rating is not a simulation result.
Article-specific sheet dated 18 September 2026: 300 mm length, 4.6 mm width, bundle 1.5 to 85 mm, inside serrations.

T50I family drawing revision 6, 21 May 2019. Thickness 1.2 +/- 0.2 mm, head height 5.8 +/- 0.3 mm, head width 7.8 +/- 0.3 mm and length 7.0 +/- 0.6 mm. Flat length 305 +/- 5 mm, bundle maximum 80 mm. Revision history changed 85 to 80 mm in 2018.
Earlier T50I family drawing revision 6, 14 August 2009 corroborates nominal section and head dimensions; length 305 +/- 5 mm, maximum bundle 80 mm.

sources.review: Viewed original manufacturer photograph: tapered rounded head, through-opening, molded plastic pawl and thin strap root.
Viewed manufacturer's family application photograph: band wraps cables and feeds through the head; black and natural variants shown.

source_conflicts: Exact article page and data sheet state 300 mm / 85 mm bundle; linked family drawings state 305 +/- 5 mm / 80 mm bundle. Use 300 mm stock and conservative 80 mm circular bundle bound; retain the discrepancy. Do not claim all nominal dimensions are an exact-article factory drawing.
inferences: Opening, pawl profile, corner radius, serration pitch and depth are photo-based local selections, not measured manufacturer dimensions.
Family 1.2 mm thickness and 5.8 mm head height are selected for this candidate; exact article-specific tolerances remain unverified.
Bent shapes, selected 0.1 mm surface gaps and flush cuts are static reference states, not evidence of tensioning, retention, ratcheting or cutting.
rights: Geometry is independently authored. Manufacturer documents, photographs and logos are referenced, not redistributed or embedded in the asset. No license to redistribute original manufacturer CAD is asserted.
